title: Freelance Transcriptionist — Oromo
description: About Perle Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver. Perle is hiring a freelance transcriptionist fluent in Oromo for a remote transcription role. This is a paid contract position open to qualified contributors worldwide. Role Overview You will transcribe 2-speaker, channel-separated audio recordings in Oromo. Each file has two clearly separated speakers. Your job is to produce a clean, accurate, sequentially ordered transcript with speaker labels and timestamps. You will be asked to complete a short qualification task — a 5-minute audio transcription sample in Oromo. Applicants who pass the qualification test will be onboarded immediately and assigned to production tasks. Perle is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Demonstrated experience in strengthening and professionalizing rural water service providers, including improving operational performance, asset management, and service delivery models.
